item.body:
Not a lot: docs-only plan fix-up (operator brief, step 1). No lot work starts before it is merged.

**Problem.** After the backup audit, `docs/LOTS.md` still blocked LOT-067 and LOT-055 on decisions that are taken (Q-1, Q-4), showed LOT-080 claimed by a Mac session that never received its brief, did not track non-lot work, and the feature backlog proposed by Bybifok only existed on an unmerged branch of the mirror. ROADMAP/README counted 52 engine lots; LOTS.md Phase 3 has 54 rows.

**What changed.**
- `docs/LOTS.md`: LOT-080 back to `—` / `todo`; LOT-067 drops `Q-1` (stays `blocked`, LOT-064 not done); LOT-055 depends on `025, 071` instead of `Q-4` (stays `blocked`, LOT-071 is `todo`); LOT-025 note and "Issues to open" #4 now wait for an **AQ capture**, added to the Capture backlog (Mac); new **Other work** section (pre-commit + CI replay, old francoisgn/ios-app_SwiftHFR#14; FEAT backlog; cutover follow-ups → ADR 0010 Accepted after EZZZ-CUTOVER step 9).
- `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md` §7b AQ RSS: "pending Q-4" → "pending AQ capture"; same update in the LOT-001 checklist row P08 and the user-feedback research note.
- `docs/FEATURES.md` (FEAT-001…021, "Not to lose") and `docs/research/bybifok-proposals.md` ported from `claude/bybifok-features-review-t3r038` (mirror, read-only), adapted to ADR 0011: FEATURES.md is the backlog, specs go to `docs/features/FEAT-XXX.md`, no required approval; the research file no longer duplicates the FEAT table. Credit kept (file, CREDITS.md row). Not ported: that branch's ADR 0010, COLLABORATION.md, scripts, CONTRIBUTING changes (superseded).
- FEATURES.md linked from AGENTS.md §2, the README documentation map and ROADMAP Phase 5.
- Counts: "23 of 54" engine lots (ROADMAP, README).

**Checks run locally.** `scripts/check-lot-deps.py` (64 lots, 0 violations), markdownlint-cli2 0.18.1 (CI version) passed, relative links of changed files resolve.
